name: Sovereign Town Benchmark Agent
description: A2A agent that runs reproducible governance-policy simulations, compares regulatory scenarios, classifies actions under EU AI Act / NIST RMF / ISO 42001 / DORA, and reads the signed public leaderboard.

skills.name: Run benchmark
skills.description: Run a single policy/scenario simulation and return scored metrics.
examples: Run sovereign policy under scarcity_shock in aqua district
Benchmark the aia_required policy on the ai_act_prohibited_ban scenario

skills.name: Compare policies
skills.description: Compare two or more comma-separated policies under the same scenario.
examples: Compare sovereign and ungoverned under baseline
Compare sovereign, strict, permissive under scarcity_shock

skills.name: Classify regulatory risk
skills.description: Classify an agent action under a chosen governance framework.
examples: What is the NIST RMF tier for 'neglect'?

skills.name: Read public leaderboard
skills.description: Fetch the signed leaderboard from a Sovereign Town harness server.
examples: How many signed runs are on the public leaderboard?
